_about: Model prices for Switch ROI (GET /api/roi), USD per million tokens, like Switch Trust's Model pricing page. Merged over the list prices in server/src/roi-calc.ts: change a row to set a negotiated rate, add a row to price a new model. A model with no row is flagged 'unpriced' (its tokens count, its dollars don't). Edits apply on the next request.
_source: Anthropic list prices, claude-api skill (cached 2026-10-06). cache_write is the 5-minute rate (1.25x input).

claude-haiku-5-5._note: Prompts up to 100K tokens. Over 100K the card is 5x: $0.50 in, $2.50 out, $0.05 cache read, $0.625 cache write. Switch's counters don't say which prompts crossed 100K, so a long-chat estimate is a floor.
